subject: Re: MAP draft and target close / procurement signature timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Reed <julia.reed@fintechco.com>, Harish Patel <harry.patel@fintechco.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0000
Subject: MAP draft + post-call notes / target close

Hi Julia / Harish 

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and next steps from our call: we reviewed high-level architecture, integration checkpoints, and procurement timeline. I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for your review (FintechCo_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx).

Highlights / proposed target dates:
- Target close: 2026-04-15 (contract signature)
- Prod pilot start: 2026-05-04
- Key dependencies: SOC2 evidence review, network allowlist, PII data-handling review

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood: onboarding plan, SOC2 summary, support SLA  Marissa
- Redwood SE: integration runbook, test harness  Camila
- FintechCo: procurement sign-off, security questionnaire completion  Julia / Procurement

Action items:
1) Please review the attached MAP and confirm any missing milestones or owners by EOD Fri (2026-03-13).
2) Share any contract/legal constraints that would move the target signature date.
3) If procurement needs a standard timeline from Redwood (e.g., lead times for PO/legal), we can provide a one-page procurement checklist.

Attachments: FintechCo_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx, SOC2_summary.pdf

Thanks  looking forward to aligning on dates.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference



>
> - Harish

From: Julia Reed <julia.reed@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Harish Patel <harry.patel@fintechco.com>, procurement@fintechco.com
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 11:27:00 -0000
Subject: Re: MAP draft + post-call notes / target close

Hi Marissa 

Appreciate the summary and MAP draft. A couple of notes from procurement/security after an initial pass:

1) Procurement windows: our legal team has a monthly contract review cadence; the next available sign-off runway would put us at ~2026-04-30 for fully-executed signatures (we can sometimes accelerate but need a firm internal justification).
2) Security: SOC2 evidence looks good from the summary, but they want an attachable artifact (attestation PDF) and a short table listing data flows for PII.
3) Responsibilities: procurement asked for a bulletized list of outstanding docs/owners and a suggested internal review timeline  can you reformat the MAP to include that?

Given the procurement window, would Redwood be open to a target signature of 2026-04-30 instead of the 2026-04-15 proposed? If so, we can align internal reviewers and commit to that date. If not possible, let us know why and we can attempt to request an exception.

Thanks,
Julia Reed
Head of Partnerships, FintechCo
julia.reed@fintechco.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Julia Reed <julia.reed@fintechco.com>
Cc: Harish Patel <harry.patel@fintechco.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:34:00 -0000
Subject: Re: MAP draft + post-call notes / target close

Thanks Julia  good context. I updated the MAP (see attached v1 comment thread) with technical milestones and dependencies so procurement can see lead times. Summary below:

Technical milestones / owners:
- Integration kickoff (week 0): Redwood SE (Camila). Deliverable: integration runbook, shared test account. Target: 1 week after contract signature.
- Allowlist/IP setup: FintechCo network team (Harish)  need list of IPs + contact. Target: 2 business days after onboarding kickoff.
- Data flow table & PII mapping: FintechCo security (Julia) + Redwood SE (Camila)  need initial draft from Redwood by 2026-03-20.
- SOC2 attestation: Redwood security  will provide attestation PDF and short summary by 2026-03-19.

Potential blockers: procurement signoff timing (Julia note), and internal FintechCo review cycles for PII mapping. I added a column in the MAP for "review window" that maps to your monthly legal cadence.

Marissa  would you like me to send a one-page procurement checklist (action + owner + target date) as a separate attachment for procurement@fintechco.com?

Camila
Staff Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com

> On Mar 12, 2026, at 11:27, Julia Reed <julia.reed@fintechco.com> wrote:
> > [procurement asks and proposed 2026-04-30 target]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Reed <julia.reed@fintechco.com>, Harish Patel <harry.patel@fintechco.com>, procurement@fintechco.com
Cc: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: MAP draft + post-call notes / target close

Hi Julia 

Thanks for the procurement context and thanks Camila for the technical breakdown. We can absolutely align to FintechCo's internal cadence  shifting the target signature to 2026-04-30 is OK from our side. Couple of ask/clarifications so we have the same expectations in the MAP:

1) Signature target vs. procurement handoff: to ensure we meet the 2026-05-04 pilot start, we request that procurement executes the contract by 2026-04-27 (PO or signed contract in your system) to give our onboarding team a 1-week buffer for provisioning and kickoff. Can you confirm if that internal milestone (procurement executes by 2026-04-27) is workable?

2) Deliverables we will provide ahead of signature: SOC2 attestation PDF (Camila flagged delivery by 2026-03-19), integration runbook + test account setup checklist, and a short procurement checklist that lists requested artifacts for your legal/procurement.

3) If procurement requires a PO and that changes timing, please flag the earliest date procurement could issue a PO  we can accept PO + signature exchange, but need to know lead times so we can commit resources.

I updated the MAP to include: milestone rows for "procurement executes" (2026-04-27) and "contract fully executed" (2026-04-30), plus owners and an explicit dependency column. Upload link (DocuSign placeholder) included below for quick signature routing once procurement confirms.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/secure/sign?doc=FTCO-MAP-v1
HubSpot: HS-234987

Next steps:
- Julia / Procurement: confirm whether 2026-04-27 execution milestone is acceptable and whether a PO will be used.
- FintechCo security: confirm receipt of SOC2 attestation when Camila shares.
- Marissa/Camila: we will send the one-page procurement checklist to procurement@fintechco.com after confirmation.

If you confirm, we'll lock the MAP and route the contract for signature targeting 2026-04-30.

Best,
Marissa
